decisions.reason: High investment, flagship status, and public visibility create strong escalation pressure to retain it.
It builds on existing training resources and has been publicly mentioned, creating moderate commitment, but less central than flagship products.
Limited investment and low public visibility make dropping easier, but its integration with customer support still favors retention.
Own-page presentation and alignment with digital efficiency goals create visible commitment and investment, favoring retention.
Close to the established offer and presented on its own page, it is central and visible, so dropping would write off substantial sunk costs.
